legal_units.title: Certain transfers to be void.
legal_units.text: Where, during the pendency of any proceeding under this Act or after the completion thereof, but before the service of notice by the Tax Recovery Officer as per the procedure specified under section 413, any assessee creates a charge on, or parts with the possession of, any of his assets in favour of any other person, such charge or transfer shall be void as against any claim in respect of any tax or any other sum payable by the assessee as a result of the completion of the said proceeding or otherwise.

legal_units.text: This section applies to cases where the amount of tax or other sum payable or likely to be payable exceeds Rs. 5000 and the assets charged or transferred exceed Rs. 10000 in value.
